_readme: GAME CONTENT, TUNABLE STARTING VALUES PENDING PRODUCER REVIEW (names, effects). Battle consumables: at most ONE per battle (lead decision), chosen before the fight and used as it begins (before team bonds and the avatar's opening passives), spent whatever the outcome. Recipients Team: every living team beast applies the effects to itself (percent BuffStat or flat CritChance); Enemies: the team's first living beast applies them to every living enemy (DebuffStat or DamageOverTime, less the enemy's status resist). Every effect lasts 1-3 of the affected unit's turns. Strength target: at most about +0.3 of a level each (a tier-1 bond), measured by the balance simulator's --economy-probe (see docs/balance/tuning-log.md). No speed consumables (a pre-battle Speed buff or debuff measured NEGATIVE in the simulator; flagged for the combat lane), no shield (a consumable shield displaces the stance bonds' longer ones and measured negative), heals (battles start at full HP), revives or cleanses in v1 (a Cleanse consumable becomes possible with the combat lane's Cleanse effect). MinRegion: the first region whose Traders stock it; MaxStack: the most the pack holds. Validated by ConsumableLibraryValidator; Editor: Beast Craft/Data/Import Consumables. See docs/design/economy-and-shop.md, 'Consumables'.

Consumables.Description: A bitter red draught: the team's blows land harder for a few turns.
A metallic tonic that hardens hide and scale.
Stinging drops that show the team every weak spot.
Stinging smoke that leaves the enemy half-blind for a few turns.
A shattering flask of venom: some of the enemy sicken.
